history.summary: CSV TOWN FLAG: the CSV town 'Geyzing' is the former name of Gyalshing - same town, district and temple; documented as Gyalshing. IDENTITY: verified as entry #33 'Gyalshing Singha Devi Mandir', location Gyalshing, on the Sikkim Ecclesiastical Department's official district-wise list of Hindu mandirs; a place-listing ('Singa Devi Mandir', Gyalshing) and the geocoder resolve it to Devi Mandir, Monastery Road, Gyalshing 737111, which is used for the coordinates. 'Singha Devi' is conventionally understood as the lion-mounted Devi, i.e. Durga - this reading is inferred from the name, not sourced, and no deity, history or festival record could be found for this specific shrine. Festival calendar below is unverified.

name: Gyalshing Singha Devi Mandir
town_description: Gyalshing is the headquarters of Gyalshing district (formerly West Sikkim) and the main gateway town for the Pelling-Yuksom tourist circuit, near Pemayangtse Monastery, Khecheopalri lake and the Kirateshwar Mahadev Temple at Legship.
tradition: Shakta (tentative - inferred from the name Singha Devi; verify)

travel.airport: Bagdogra Airport, West Bengal, about 140 km from Gyalshing (verify).
travel.railway: New Jalpaiguri (NJP) Station, West Bengal, about 130 km (verify).
travel.road: On the Jorethang-Legship-Gyalshing route; shared and private taxis run from Jorethang and Pelling; Gyalshing is about 25 km from Pelling.

visitor_information.best_time: March to May and October to December, the usual Sikkim season.
